newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak central bank bill auction fails to attract bids.
newsitem.headline: Slovak central bank bill auction fails to attract bids.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Wednesday said its Dutch-style auction of an unspecified tranche of three-month liquidity bills failed to attract bids.
It was the 16th time this year that there were either no bids at an NBS bill auction or that all were rejected outright.
"The NBS was (again) not willing to accept the higher yields banks requested," Pavol Kruk, a money market dealer at Istrobanka, told Reuters.
Dealers said bids hovered around 10 percent. In its last successful auction of similar bills on August 28, the NBS set the yield at 9.3 percent after 9.3 percent on August 21.
